name: Slack Support Tickets to Linear
description: Find ticket-tagged Slack messages, check existing Linear issue hashes, generate structured support details and create the new tickets in order.
requirements: Slack user connection with search:read and access to the configured channel
Linear connection with issue read/create access and configured team/state IDs
Five-minute schedule initially in UTC; avoid overlapping executions and review finite deduplication window
